clauses.title: Provider-mutation exceptions remain exact in the AC-AUTOFIX contract section
requires: provider mutation other than `REPLY_EXCEPTION` and CL-D31 optional body PATCH/ledger POST
clauses.section: ## AC-AUTOFIX — Autofix token grants only bounded CL-D30 actions

clauses.title: Autofix token grants only bounded CL-D30 actions
requires: The exact PR token itself is the run-scoped approval only for the smallest CL-D30 correction batch per reviewed public head: one normal commit, one non-force push, and `REPLY_EXCEPTION`.
It does not authorize merge, force-push, amend, rebase, history rewriting
